sources.org: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union, with Eurostat
sources.title: Data on Taxation Trends: National Tax Lists (NTL), edition 2026
sources.note: Workbook "NTL edition 2026 web.xlsx", sheet MT: every tax and social contribution by its national name and ESA code, in EUR million. Data cut-off 30 October 2025.

sources.title: Main national accounts tax aggregates (gov_10a_taxag)
sources.note: Taxes and social contributions by sub-sector and ESA item; for Malta everything is under central government (S.1311) or the EU institutions (S.212).

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Malta – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: company income tax a flat 35%; an optional 15% rate under the FITWI Regulations of 2 September 2025.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Malta – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: graduated progressive rates from 0% to 35%.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Malta – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT 18%, 7% and 5%; social security contributions 10% from the employee and 10% from the employer on the basic weekly wage, 15% for the self-employed.
